## Blue Triangle jobs: common questions

Is Blue Triangle hiring right now?Blue Triangle has no open roles listed as of November 9, 2026. Roles appear here as soon as they are posted on Blue Triangle's careers site.

Where is Blue Triangle headquartered?Blue Triangle is headquartered in Mechanicsville, VA, United States.

Who leads Blue Triangle?Lance Ullom, CEO, is at the top of Blue Triangle's org chart.

How do I apply for a job at Blue Triangle?Pick a role on Blue Triangle's TheJobsMap page and select Apply. Every listing links to the original posting on Blue Triangle's own careers site, so you apply directly with the employer.
